The Shepherd reaches the gate, but the black dog stands in the gateway and he steps back.
episodes.cliffhanger: Keys jingle behind the sealed passage and Wren's voice calls: 'Odo? Come and get me. But don't come alone.' The black dog walks to the sealed passage and looks back, waiting.
